name: icmi
description: ICMI is part of the BOP (Benchmark for 6D Object Pose Estimation) collection and measures object detection and 6D pose estimation performance from RGB/RGB‑D images in realistic, cluttered scenes. The benchmark evaluates algorithms on their ability to localize and estimate object orientations under occlusion and varying lighting. It is intended to reflect real-world industrial and robotic manipulation scenarios.
evaluation_method: BOP score (pose estimation accuracy / pose error based metrics)
reputation: Part of the established BOP benchmark suite used by the 6D pose estimation and robotics vision community for standardized evaluation.
